outcome: Fibrotic markers (trichrome and smooth muscle actin staining)
Persistence and distribution of fat droplets in lungs
cohort: 18 rats received triolein and 18 control rats received saline, followed by a second insult of LPS or saline.
finding: Rats exposed to fat embolism (triolein) showed more severe vascular and fibrotic lung damage when subsequently exposed to lipopolysaccharide (LPS) 6 weeks later, indicating increased lung sensitivity to a second insult.
followup_time: 6 weeks after initial triolein exposure, with necropsy 48 hours after the second LPS exposure.
